scope: Explicit model-copy development diagnostics bound to current/best weights, admitted train/validation views, ordered subsets, intervention and exposure hashes.
limits: Development selection is not independent test evidence or calibration.
Model hash is not checkpoint-file identity or proof of full training history.
Copying/hashing adds memory and CPU work; no accelerator performance qualification.
Concurrent arbitrary mutation is detected only by stated postchecks, not transactionally rolled back.
